        topK: 20
    }
)
YIELD

name: 02- Membuat graph dengan relasi G>=4
query:
// Membuat graf sementara dengan rating minimal rating >= 4.0 
MATCH (m:Movie)-[ r:Rating]->( u:User)
WHERE r.rating >= 4.0 
WITH gds.graph.project('moviePositive',m,u) AS g 
RETURN 
    g.graphName AS graphName,
    g.nodeCount AS jumlahNode,
    g.relationshipCount AS jumlahRelasi;

    'movieSimilarityGraph',
    {
        relationshipWeightProperty: 'score',

)

name: 08 - jumlah daftar film dan komunitasnya
query:
//daftar film dan komunitasnya melihat daftar film berdasarkan komunitasnya  
MATCH (m:Movie)
WHERE m.louvainCommunityId IS NOT NULL
RETURN
    m.movieId AS movieId,
    m.title AS judulFilm,
    m.genres AS genres,
    m.louvainCommunityId AS communityId
ORDER BY communityId, judulFilm
LIMIT 100;

name: 09-melihat ringkasan genre setiap komunitas
query:
// melihat ringkasan genre setiap komunitas 
MATCH (m:Movie)
WHERE m.louvainCommunityId IS NOT NULL
UNWIND split(coalesce(m.genres, ''), '|') AS genre
WITH m.louvainCommunityId AS communityId, genre, count(*) AS jumlah
WHERE genre <> '' AND genre <> '(no genres listed)'
RETURN
    communityId,
    genre,
    jumlah
ORDER BY communityId, jumlah DESC;

name: 07-melihat jumlah film dan contoh film dan perkomunitasnya
query:
// melihat jumlah film dan contoh film dan perkomunitasnya


MATCH (m:Movie)
WHERE m.louvainCommunityId IS NOT NULL
WITH
    m.louvainCommunityId AS communityId,
    count(m) AS jumlahFilm,
    collect(m.title) AS daftarFilm
RETURN
    communityId,
    jumlahFilm,
    daftarFilm[0..10] AS contohFilm
ORDER BY jumlahFilm DESC
LIMIT 10;

name: Analisis genre pada 10 komunitas terbesar
query:
// Analisis genre pada 10 komunitas terbesar
MATCH (m:Movie)
WHERE m.louvainCommunityId IS NOT NULL
WITH
    m.louvainCommunityId AS communityId,
    count(m) AS jumlahFilm
ORDER BY jumlahFilm DESC
LIMIT 10
WITH collect(communityId) AS komunitasTerbesar

MATCH (m:Movie)
WHERE m.louvainCommunityId IN komunitasTerbesar
UNWIND split(coalesce(m.genres, ''), '|') AS genre
WITH
    m.louvainCommunityId AS communityId,
    genre,
    count(*) AS jumlahFilm
WHERE genre <> ''
  AND genre <> '(no genres listed)'
RETURN
    communityId,
    genre,
    jumlahFilm
ORDER BY communityId, jumlahFilm DESC;
